name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo Vargas's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's auto repair shop in Lima. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering and quickly ascended through the ranks of Peruvian rally teams, initially as an engineer before showcasing leadership qualities that led to managerial roles. Vargas is known for his meticulous approach and ability to motivate his staff. 

As a team principal, Ricardo emphasizes data-driven decision-making and fostering a collaborative environment. He believes that open communication and a shared vision are crucial for success. His experience in diverse racing environments has given him a unique perspective on resource management and strategic planning. Vargas is dedicated to building a winning culture at ProSport Racing, driven by a commitment to excellence at every level. While not the most innovative, Ricardo is a very solid and dependable manager.

Despite his calm and collected demeanor, Ricardo is fiercely competitive and deeply invested in the team's success. He is known for his ability to identify and nurture young talent, providing opportunities for up-and-coming engineers and drivers to shine.

physical.description: Ricardo has a strong build and a focused gaze, conveying his authority and experience.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses when under pressure.
Starts every team meeting with a brief motivational quote.
